svg.aria-label: Four classifiers fitted to the same ring-shaped two-class problem: logistic regression fails completely, k-nearest neighbours and the RBF support vector machine recover the ring, and the depth-four tree approximates it with axis-aligned boxes
svg.text: Same data, same features, four different inductive biases.
The tree's boxes are cheap at inference — a handful of comparisons — but they can only ever be boxes.
The RBF SVM draws the right shape and pays for it with stored support vectors.
Choosing a model family is choosing which shapes are cheap to express.
